# Eire Reborn - Update 4 (Britannia) triggers, generated by tools/gen_script_brit.py
# The Empire of Britannia has 93 counties in the installed game: 30% = 28, 60% = 56, 95% = 89.

eir_brit_30_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= 28
		empire = title:e_britannia
	}
}

eir_brit_60_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= 56
		empire = title:e_britannia
	}
}

eir_brit_95_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= 89
		empire = title:e_britannia
	}
}

# Every county of Wales.
eir_wales_all_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		count >= 13
		kingdom = title:k_wales
	}
}

eir_irish_king_trigger = {
	culture = culture:irish
	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
}

eir_gael_king_trigger = {
	culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic }
	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
}

eir_holds_both_kingdoms_trigger = {
	has_title = title:k_ireland
	has_title = title:k_scotland
}

eir_tintagel_built_trigger = {
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		any_county_province = { has_building = eir_tintagel_01 }
	}
}

	any_sub_realm_county = {

	}
}

	any_sub_realm_county = {

	}
}

}

	any_sub_realm_county = { this = title:c_cornwall }
